name: Crow & Foxy
source:
Perch’d on a lofty oak, Sir Raven held a lunch of cheese... You should know how the story ends.

[Taken from https://pierrecorbinais.com/2017/05/03/crow-and-foxy/]
translation:
雷文爵士栖息在一棵高大的橡树上，享用了一顿奶酪午餐……你应该知道故事的结局。

[摘自https://pierrecorbinais.com/2017/05/03/crow-and-foxy/]
